name: Abia de la Obispalía (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue above and yellow below, within a red border, charged in the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Abia de la Obispalía (a bishop's staff and mitre on blue within a bordure of roundels).
history: Municipal flag of Abia de la Obispalía; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Abia de la Obispalía arms — bishop's staff and mitre within a bordure of roundels
